title: The synthesis of a 3d–4f polynuclear metal cluster under microwave irradiation: crystal structure and magnetic property of [La3Ni6(IDA)6(OH)6(H2O)12]·3NO3·15H2O (IDA = iminodiacetate)

synthesis.procedure: Microwave route (primary): Ni(NO3)2·6H2O (0.581 g, 2.0 mmol) and iminodiacetic acid (0.266 g, 2.0 mmol) were dissolved in 8 mL deionized water and stirred for 10 min. La(NO3)3·6H2O (0.866 g, 2.0 mmol) and 8 mL chromatogram-pure acetonitrile were added. The pH was slowly adjusted to about 7.0–7.5 with 1.0 mol L−1 NaOH. The mixture was sealed in a 35 mL quartz vessel and heated at 100 °C under microwave irradiation for 30 min (pressure about 5–10 psi). The resulting pellucid solution was evaporated at room temperature for one day to give light-green flake-shaped crystals in 40.0% yield based on La(NO3)3. Alternative reflux route: the same reagent mixture was transferred to a 25 mL conical flask, refluxed at 100 °C for 3 days, cooled at 1.0 °C min−1, and the filtrate evaporated at room temperature; crystals formed after two weeks in 28.5% yield based on La(NO3)3.
synthesis.temperature: 100 °C (microwave or reflux); crystallization at room temperature
synthesis.time: microwave 30 min, then 1 day crystallization; reflux 3 days, then 2 weeks crystallization
synthesis.vessel_or_method: 35 mL quartz vessel, microwave irradiation (5–10 psi); alternative 25 mL conical flask reflux
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Microwave product: pellucid solution evaporated at room temperature for one day, light-green flake crystals. Reflux product: cooled at 1.0 °C min−1; filtrate evaporated at room temperature for two weeks.
synthesis.yield: 40.0% (microwave, based on La(NO3)3); 28.5% (reflux, based on La(NO3)3)

properties.summary: Cage-shaped ferromagnetic La3Ni6 cluster. Magnetism arises from six Ni(II) ions (La(III) is diamagnetic). χmT is nearly constant from 75–300 K, then rises at low T due to ferromagnetic Ni···Ni exchange via syn–anti carboxylato bridges in a hexagonal Ni6 ring; a slight drop below 2.8 K is attributed to intercluster antiferromagnetism, ZFS, and/or saturation. MAGPACK fit of Hamiltonian (1) gives J = +0.50 cm−1, D = 0.90 cm−1, g = 2.18.
